response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates extensive senior-level experience in software development, IT architecture, and team leadership across multiple industries, including IT consulting, open-source projects, and high-performance systems. His technical depth in modern stacks (TypeScript, Node.js, Dlang, Python-like scripting) and leadership in mentoring teams aligns well with the Head of Development role. However, his German proficiency is at a basic level (not C1 as required), and while his GitLab/GitHub presence is strong, explicit UML expertise and project management experience are not prominently highlighted.
strengths: Proven track record in leading interdisciplinary teams and mentoring developers
Extensive experience in open-source technologies and Linux/Unix environments (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
Strong background in high-performance systems, micro-services, and scalable architectures (e.g., Dunnhumby, Optilyz)
concerns: German language proficiency is only at a basic level (not meeting the C1 requirement)
Lack of explicit mention of UML expertise or formal project management credentials
Limited direct experience in IT security, risk management, or compliance (key for client advisory role)
